---
title: Backend reference
---

This reference has a page for each module of the Python package `api`, the FastAPI backend. smalldocs imports the package
and writes these pages from its docstrings and the comments beside the parameters. The pages show the
public functions and classes of each module. A public name does not start with `_`, so the private
helpers and Python's own methods, such as `__init__`, are not here.

The pages of the routers, such as [batting](batting.qmd), list the functions that answer each
endpoint. [The HTTP reference](../http/index.qmd) gives the same endpoints by their paths. The other
pages, such as [filters](filters.qmd) and [wilson](wilson.qmd), hold the code that the routers share.
